## Checklist

- [ ] Designation is unissued and follows its series format
- [ ] Front matter validates (`npm run build` passes)
- [ ] Register is clinical throughout; no commentary or emphasis
- [ ] Vocabulary is specimen / subject / entity
- [ ] No more than one withheld figure (two in a long record)
- [ ] Describes a category of behaviour, not an individual; no identifying detail
